args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 1 flagged, 7 cleared.
Flagged: r05 (summary_outlier). Its largest flank difference is -0.81 %/h. The batch median is 0.495 %/h, so the sign is reversed and the gap is about 1.3 %/h (z -16). Its growth zone is 674 µm, against 695 µm for every other root. All its checks pass, but the strain-rate profile has a different shape from the rest of the batch.
Cleared: r01, r02, r03, r04, r06, r07, r08. All final checks pass. All have the centre REGR peak about 53.2 %/h at 421 µm and a 695 µm growth zone. In r04 and r07 the width-free ratio is -0.04 instead of 0.04. That is a 0.08 difference near zero, and the only remedy kept was the normal width-free one, with no roll-backs.
What the flagged run shows: only r05 has a different curvature-rate (flank difference) profile. Because it passes every check, the problem shows up only when it is compared with the batch.
Note: several cleared runs have identical checks and summaries (r01/r03/r08 and r02/r06, with r04/r07 differing only in the width-free ratio). It may be worth confirming that these are separate roots or time windows.
